# Six Positions, Eight Turns

## #0 — Keep the two address systems distinct

The input is the six-position body generated by [binary self-relation](binary-and-binary-of-binary.md). The [core theorem spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), §II, supplies two readings: the qualitative determination of a knowing-act and the processual slash-form at each position. This record places the tables together so a repeated sign does not cause one operation to replace another.

## #1 — The qualitative body

| Position | Determination | Distinct operation |
|---|---|---|
| #0 | 0/1 | Conscious circumstance |
| #1 | ?/! | Questioning and asserting |
| #2 | −/+ | Reserve and issue |
| #3 | X/x | Determining capacity and recurrence |
| #4 | AM/IS | Personed context |
| #5 | ∞/dx | Local exactness and unbounded horizon |

[The definition projection](../definition/six-determinations.md) derives each transition rather than assigning these meanings from the count alone.

## #2 — The slash-form reading

| Position | Slash-form | Office in the processual reading |
|---|---|---|
| #0 | (0/1)/(1/0) | Full parent relation |
| #1 | 0/0 = % | Native indeterminate potency |
| #2 | 0/1 | Expression |
| #3 | 1/0 = ?/! | Incomputable inverse |
| #4 | 1/1 = 100% | Achieved wholeness |
| #5 | (1/0)/(0/1) | Full inverse parent |

The `%` reading of `0/0` is native notation; ordinary division does not assign it a stable scalar. The qualitative `?/!` at #1 and the processual `?/!` at #3 have different offices. Their relation is not a numbering error to repair.

## #3 — Bracket the six

The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the qualitative body, and `1/0` returns its achieved expression towards ground. Thus the traversal has eight turns while the positional body has six:

$$
-/-\;\to\;[0/1,\;?/!,\;-/+,\;X/x,\;AM/IS,\;\infty/dx]\;\to\;1/0.
$$

The brackets display an address distinction, not an instruction to identify all forms of `1/0` with one serial stage. The inverse relation can be active locally within the sixfold and globally as the returning threshold.

## #4 — Harmonics and inverse phase

The qualitative forward pairs are Being `0–1`, Becoming `2–3`, and Knowing/unKnowing `4–5`. Complementary folds are Essence `0+5`, Constitution `1+4`, and Text–Texture `2+3`. A pair shared by both readings remains one pair doing two relational jobs.

[Process](../process/README.md) extends the full chain and its inverse-phase positions. Definition/quilt retain the short chain. File 2's inverse-phase primes and File 3's Night-pass primes are distinguished by their source-local tables; the shared glyph gives no licence to merge them.

## #5→0 — Return with the correct address

The result is a cross-readable field in which each sign retains the operation that places it. A local `?/!` can now be followed to its corresponding definition or process without silently moving the other.

This record returns-to [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) and [Movement25](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md). The [root spine-index](../../eight-determinations.md) gathers the twelvefold relation layer that these exact placements serve.
